rows.name: question_block 16x16 tile-id table (53 55 54 56, column-major)
rows.notes: PRG source of the four tile ids that make a 16x16 ? block. Entry at prgRom 0xC8C (CPU $8C8C), 4 bytes in column-major order [top-left, bottom-left, top-right, bottom-right] = 53 55 54 56; the nametable therefore gets $53/$54 on the top row and $55/$56 on the bottom row. It is one entry of a 4-byte-per-entry block table at prgRom 0xC84-0xCA3 (8 entries: B0 B1 B2 B3 / 77 79 77 79 / 53 55 54 56 / 53 55 54 56 / A5 A7 A6 A8 / C2 C4 C3 C5 / 57 59 58 5A / 7B 7D 7C 7E); the identical entry at 0xC90 is not the one World 1-1's ? blocks use. PROOF: write_memory prgRom 0xC8C $53 -> $00 (ledger seq 1, reason 'change ? block top-left tile id'), reset_emulator, replayed Start/Start to World 1-1; get_tile_at_pixel on the floating ? block's top-left quadrant then returned tile_id 0 (palette 3, chr_tile $100 = the HUD '0' glyph) while the other three quadrants stayed $54/$55/$56, and the screenshot showed a '0' glyph where every on-screen ? block's top-left corner had been. undo_edit restored $53. Found by search_memory for the tile run in prgRom (no reference imported).

rows.name: small Mario standing-frame tile ids (3A 37 4F 4F)
rows.notes: PRG source of the sprite tile ids for small Mario's standing pose. The four tile ids 3A 37 4F 4F sit contiguously at prgRom 0x6ED3 (CPU $EED3) in a player-graphics table; the game reads them as part of an 8-byte record [FC FC FC FC 3A 37 4F 4F] where the leading $FC blank tiles pad small Mario to the 2x4 big-Mario OAM box (2 wide, 4 tall), so OAM shows four blank entries then 3A,37 over 4F,4F(flipped). Neighbouring records are other poses (e.g. 0x6E8B = 3A 37 3B 3C, 0x6EC3 = 3A 37 92 93). PROOF: write_memory prgRom 0x6ED3 $3A -> $FC (ledger seq 1, reason 'change small Mario standing-frame top-left tile id'), reset_emulator; list_sprites then returned chr_tile 252 (blank, opaque:false) for the top-left cell at (40,193) that had read 58 ($3A), and get_pixel_color(45,196) read the hill green $1A where the old tile had content while (48,196) still read Mario skin $27. undo_edit restored $3A. Found by search_memory for the tile run in prgRom (no reference imported).
